audience_problem: A fictional adult arranges a self-made checklist; a blank gap leads her back to the official guide.

hook.text: What did her neat little checklist leave out?

packaging.title: One Card Was Missing From Her Checklist
packaging.promise: The empty space becomes a specific question to verify, not a recruitment prompt.

sources.claim: The U.S. registration guide requires a sponsor and describes automatic or manual sponsor designation.

retention_beats.purpose: Narration turn: Mira lines up three cards. The empty space bothers her, so she opens the source.
Narration turn: Atomy’s U.S. registration guide requires a sponsor and describes automatic or manual designation.
Narration turn: She adds a fourth card: understand the sponsor step. A tidy summary can still miss a decision.
Narration turn: The official guide is in the caption.

experiment.assignment_note: Three videos per variant across three topic families. Observational matched batch, not a randomized causal test.

review_scope: Packaging-to-script alignment reviewed. No claim of audience performance or automatic fact checking.
